answer.rationale: memory_57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. memory_44 links sales assistance to enterprise pipeline quality, but omits closed revenue and long-term retention. memory_73 reports revenue lift in the relevant price-sensitive SMB segment, but omits margin, customer quality, retention, and post-promotion durability. memory_31 shows a durable activation improvement, while memory_86 shows better onboarding and early adoption; both rely on product-use proxies rather than qualified revenue. memory_91 is weakest because it reports only week-one engagement and first-action gains, with no evidence of durability, conversion, retention, or revenue.
